Name: Stardew Duel Arena  Challenge Any NPC
Author: ttxxxxx1
Description:
[size=4][b]DDescription
Press the K key to duel with NPCs. Winning will earn rewards. The more consecutive wins, the better the rewards.

Installation Instructions
Install the latest version of SMAPI.
Extract the mod folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods directory.

Skill actions will be improved later ...Have you ever wondered what would happen if every villager in Stardew Valley had their own fighting style?
Stardew Duel Arena turns Pelican Town’s residents into fully playable duel opponents. Walk close to an NPC and press K to challenge them. You and the selected character will be moved into the vanilla Community Center for a dedicated one-on-one battle.
The mod keeps the player’s and NPC’s original appearance. Clothes, hairstyles, hats, shoes, and character sprites are not replaced with generic fighter costumes. Both characters use directional movement and walking animations, so they turn and animate naturally while moving around the battle area.
Combat is built around movement, basic attacks, defensive timing, energy management, and special abilities. Player actions include standard attacks, ranged techniques, rapid movement skills, counterattacks, and a powerful ultimate ability that requires a full energy gauge.
NPCs are not limited to a few recolored templates. Major vanilla characters have individually assigned skills based on their personality, occupation, interests, and story. Their attacks use different timing, movement patterns, hazards, projectiles, traps, summons, tracking behavior, knockback, pulling effects, healing, freezing, and area control.
For example:
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Abigail uses amethyst blades and adventurer-style rapid slashes. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Sebastian uses shadow movement, ambush attacks, and dark familiar effects. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Sam attacks with guitar sound waves and fast movement techniques. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Haley uses camera flashes, dazzling attacks, and visual disruption. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Wizard creates arcane circles, tracking magic, and delayed spell zones. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Willy uses fishing hooks, pulling attacks, and wave-like fish projectiles. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Clint uses falling anvils, furnace grids, and heavy metal attacks. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Marnie summons animal rushes and enclosure-style trapping attacks. [/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Custom NPCs are also supported. When a character does not have a manually defined moveset, the mod creates a stable skill combination based on that NPC’s internal name. This ensures custom characters can still participate without all using the same fallback attack.
Skills are presented with programmatically drawn pixel-art symbols instead of plain colored rectangles. Effects include flames, blades, stars, shadows, music notes, books, leaves, fish, shields, gears, bombs, cameras, animals, magical circles, impact bursts, warning markers, and movement trails.
Attacks use a multi-stage animation system:
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][b]Windup — the character turns toward the opponent, prepares the attack, and displays charging effects. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Release — the skill activates, often with a step, lunge, cast, or movement animation. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Impact — projectiles, traps, strikes, or area effects apply damage and visual feedback. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Recovery — the character briefly finishes the animation before returning to normal movement. [/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]This prevents characters from standing completely still while instantly spawning attacks.
Winning a duel increases your current streak and total victory count. Rewards improve as the streak rises, including gold and items such as coffee, gold bars, iridium bars, diamonds, and Prismatic Shards. Losing, drawing, or forfeiting ends the current streak, while your best streak and total victories remain saved.
The difficulty can scale with total victories and current streak, allowing opponents to become faster, tougher, and more aggressive as the player continues winning.
The duel takes place in a separate combat state and safely restores the player and NPC when the match ends. Their original position, direction, animation state, and location are restored so the duel does not permanently interrupt normal NPC schedules.[/b][/size]
